title: Sundara Purushan
desc: A man loves his cousin, but circumstances force him to leave home. Years later, when he learns that she loves someone else, he tries to help her reunite with her lover.

title: Inga Enna Solluthu
desc: A woman's drastic action to endanger her life triggers the memories of her husband's past. These recollections compel him to reflect upon his mistakes and repent for it.

title: Thadaiyara Thaakka
desc: Selva plans to expand his business and settle down, but circumstances pit him against Maha, a loan shark. However, when Maha suddenly dies, Kumar, his brother, blames Selva and seeks revenge.

title: Kunguma Pottu Gounder
desc: Kandasamy is desperate to enrol his son in a good school. Trouble ensues when his wife spots him with an educated woman who is posing as their child's mother in order to help him get admission.

title: Engal Anna
desc: Prabhakar and Bhavani are deeply in love with each other. However, lovers turn enemies when Prabhakar's father is falsely accused of killing Bhavani's father.
